Give one decimal place. Answer: 9.5. Verification: $183,880.50 divided by the $19,400 annual advantage. Recovery is measured against the true cost, not against tuition alone. t2-p5: Which of the two parts of the true cost is larger for Marcus? Answer: The earnings he gives up.
